title: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.39455v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. Building on this observation, we propose Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and performs AT by upda

translated_title: 面向参数高效对抗训练的稀疏微调
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络在许多任务上取得了优异性能，但仍然容易受到对抗性扰动的攻击。对抗训练（AT）是最有效的防御方法之一，但它在大型模型上存在内存开销高的问题，并且始终面临干净样本准确率与鲁棒准确率之间的权衡。最近的研究将参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）引入对抗训练，但这种约束导致其鲁棒性与全参数对抗训练相比存在明显差距。在这项工作中，我们从参数空间的视角重新审视参数高效的对抗微调。通过梯度分析，我们发现对抗优化高度集中于一小部分参数上，我们将其称为鲁棒性关键参数，这表明鲁棒性被编码在一个稀疏子空间中。基于这一观察，我们提出了稀疏对抗微调（SAFT），它通过对抗梯度显著性识别RCPs，并仅更新这些参数来执行对抗训练。
tldr: 该论文发现对抗训练的鲁棒性集中编码在一小部分“鲁棒性关键参数”构成的稀疏子空间中，并提出稀疏对抗微调（SAFT），通过对抗梯度显著性识别这些关键参数并仅对其进行更新，从而在大幅降低内存开销的同时消除了与全参数对抗训练之间的鲁棒性差距。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that adversarial robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace of Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), and proposes Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and updates only these parameters, achieving parameter-efficient adversarial training while closing the robustness gap of low-rank methods like LoRA.
